summary: Split the second preterit example out of the first example’s note

data.turoyo: “aḥuno, ŭno mazraqli. hat mə səmlox?” omər “ašər”, omər “ŭno-ste ḥreli”
data.translation: “Bruder, ich habe mein Wasser gelassen. Was hast du gemacht?” Der andere spricht: “Wahrlich, ich habe gekackt”

rationale: The note contains a complete second quotation with its own translation and reference 6/95. It belongs as a separate example in the same Preterit box. Preserve the supplied wording when splitting it.
Durch governs the accusative; masculine singular Harn requires meinen. The same grammatical slip appears in the supplied edition translation, but is still an evident German error.
